about_the_game:
🩸 Story & World

"A girl who lost her memories was invited to a strange place where emotions hold value."

When she awoke, she had forgotten everything. Her name, her past, why she was here. She found herself standing in a mysterious facility called VOID RED, where an "auction" was being held to reclaim memories.

VOID RED gathers "guests" who have similarly lost their memories. Each holds "Psyche Cards" that quantify emotions into numerical values, submitting these cards to bid on "items" of unknown origin to win back memories.

This story depicts the journey of a girl without memories becoming "someone." Reclaiming memories isn't about knowing the past—it's about choosing emotions, facing others, and shaping yourself.

VOID RED is the intersection of memory and emotion. And your choices will awaken her "instincts."

🎮 About the Game

"Infuse your emotions into cards and bid for memories. Victory and defeat shape your character."

VOID RED is an interactive card game themed around memory and emotion. As a girl who has lost her memories, you are invited to VOID RED to challenge other guests in sealed-bid auctions using "Psyche Cards."

🔸 Psyche Card System

  • In a world where emotions have value, cards possess attributes like "Forgiveness," "Rejection," "Anxiety," "Hope," "Anger," and "Loss," with emotional intensity quantified numerically.

  • Select cards based on item themes, infuse them with psyche values, and submit. Win to acquire memories; lose and proceed to the next floor with blank spaces.

🔸 Auction Rules

  • Sealed-bid format: Submit without seeing opponents' psyche values.

  • Routes branch based on victories and defeats. Win to access memory floors; lose to enter blank floors.

  • Psyche Cards can only be obtained through dialogue with the administrator Alv. Your choices determine the types of cards received.

Your choices shape who she becomes. Not stealing memories, but touching them. Not fighting, but exchanging emotions. Not winning, but remembering.

VOID RED is a place to confront your own emotions.
